content_text:
I just watched a 35mm print of The Zone of Interest in the Vista in Los Angeles a few hours ago and was just so taken back by the film-making on screen, the cinematography especially.
I’d love to hear Łukasz’ creative process and prep for this project and also get a more in depth discussion about his creative collaboration with Director Jonathan Glazer and Production Designer Chris Oddy.
